title: Finite covering axioms and continuity on a fixed category colimit
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories. For each $j$, let $P_j$ be a precoverage [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with singleton isomorphism coverings, finite indexed composition and base-change closure [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and pullbacks along covering arrows. Every covering presieve has finitely many distinct arrows. Every transition functor sends covering presieves to covering presieves and preserves pullbacks of a covering arrow along any arrow. Let $V$ be a cocone of $F$ whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ such that a presieve on $Y$ belongs to $Q(Y)$ exactly when it is a transported image of a covering presieve of some $P_j$ along $V_j$. Then $Q$ has singleton isomorphism coverings, finite indexed composition and base-change closure, and pullbacks along covering arrows. Every $V_j$ preserves the pullbacks of a $P_j$-covering arrow along any arrow, and is continuous for $P_j.\mathrm{toGrothendieck}$ and $Q.\mathrm{toGrothendieck}$, meaning precomposition sends set-valued sheaves to sheaves.

theorem colimit_site_covering_construction
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)) :
        ∃ (_ : Q.HasIsos) (_ : Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition)
          (_ : Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange) (_ : Q.HasPullbacks),
          (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor) ∧
          Nonempty (∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
            (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck)
